comp-m9ljs1kz.html: Salesforce CPQ is sunsetting—are you ready for what’s next?

comp-m9lj6iyh.html:
Salesforce has announced the retirement of its legacy CPQ platform. Every organization currently using CPQ will need to transition to Revenue Cloud to stay aligned with Salesforce’s roadmap and maintain future support.
But not all migration paths are created equal.

comp-m9ljxb34.html: Meet CPQShift: The Smartest Way to Move Forward

comp-m9ljxb36.html:
CPQShift is a purpose-built migration solution designed specifically to accelerate, simplify, and optimize the move from CPQ to Revenue Cloud—at a fraction of the time and cost of traditional consulting projects.
Developed by Steel Cloud, a trusted partner with deep expertise in manufacturing, distribution, and field service operations, CPQShift combines automation, machine learning, and deep quoting logic to deliver a smarter migration

comp-m9lk80p2.html: Why CPQShift?

comp-m9lk80p42.html:
✅ Purpose-Built for CPQ to Revenue Cloud
Not a generic tool. Not a cobbled-together workaround. CPQShift was architected from the ground up to handle the nuances of CPQ data, product configuration, pricing rules, and approval workflows.
✅ Powered by AI and Machine Learning
Our platform doesn’t just copy data—it understands it. CPQShift intelligently cleans, maps, and validates your quoting structures using real-time automation and predictive modeling.
✅ Faster, More Accurate, and Lower Cost
We replace months of manual consulting effort with intelligent automation—reducing error rates, minimizing downtime, and delivering your Revenue Cloud instance faster and more cost-effectively than traditional services.
✅ Real-Time Validation & Error Prevention
Built-in logic ensures that quoting rules, pricing tiers, and product bundles are migrated and validated dynamically—no more broken workflows or unexpected data gaps.
✅ Scales with Your Business
CPQShift evolves with your product lines, pricing models, and sales strategy. Your new Revenue Cloud instance becomes a dynamic, learning-enabled platform—not just a static rebuild.

comp-m9lkbe5c1.html: Built for Complex Industries and Use Cases

comp-m9lkhybh.html: We understand that your quoting logic isn’t simple, your data isn’t clean, and your timelines are tight. That’s exactly why we built CPQShift.

comp-m9lkbe5i1__item-a8e0d336-0612-46b2-.html: Technology & Subscription-Based Sales

comp-m9lkbe5l.html: CPQShift is built for the complex quoting demands of modern manufacturers—handling multi-level BOMs, configurable products, and custom pricing models with precision. Accelerate your move to Revenue Cloud without sacrificing the intricate logic that drives your shop floor.

comp-m9lkbe5l__item1.html: CPQShift is built for the complex quoting demands of modern manufacturers—handling multi-level BOMs, configurable products, and custom pricing models with precision. Accelerate your move to Revenue Cloud without sacrificing the intricate logic that drives your shop floor.

comp-m9lkbe5l__item-kes5qvaj.html: For fast-moving distributors, accuracy and speed are everything. CPQShift streamlines the migration of bundled SKUs, pricing tiers, and territory-based rules to Revenue Cloud—ensuring a seamless transition that keeps your sales pipeline flowing.

comp-m9lkbe5l__item-kes5qvil.html: CPQShift understands the hybrid nature of field service sales—part product, part service, all complexity. From install packages to service-level agreements, we migrate your quoting engine with built-in logic that mirrors how your teams work in the field.

comp-m9lkbe5l__item-a8e0d336-0612-46b2-8.html: Recurring revenue, tiered pricing, user-based licenses—subscription-based models need more than just a data transfer. CPQShift intelligently maps and validates your CPQ setup to Revenue Cloud, preserving your billing structures and renewal workflows.

comp-m9lkbe5l__item-584bb84b-238d-42f5-b.html: Automotive sales rely on dynamic pricing, incentive structures, and ever-changing configurations. CPQShift brings clarity and consistency to your quoting process—migrating complex CPQ logic to Revenue Cloud with speed and accuracy.

Let’s make your migration not just smooth—but strategic.
